description: Waheguru created the sun to give light and warmth to the whole world. Every morning it rises to remind us of His beautiful gift.
A lotus grows in muddy water but stays clean and beautiful. Gurbani uses it to teach us to live in this world while staying pure in our heart.
Water gives life to every living thing. Waheguru placed water on earth so that all creatures can drink, grow, and survive.
The moon lights up the dark night sky with a soft, gentle glow. It is one of Waheguru's many beautiful creations.
Flowers bloom with colour and sweet fragrance. Gurbani reminds us that, just like a flower, our life is a precious and short gift from Waheguru.
Birds fly freely through the sky, singing every day. Gurbani compares our soul to a bird that longs to return home to Waheguru.
A river flows gently and never stops giving water to the fields and villages it passes. Waheguru's love for us flows just like a river — always and for everyone.
Fire gives warmth and light in the darkness. In Gurbani, fire is also a symbol of the burning love a soul feels for Waheguru.
